methodology.target: Actual release Rust/WASM WasmEngine through JSON dispatch in headless Chromium with the FlowRuntime UI loaded
methodology.workflow: Trigger -> Transform -> Condition -> branch Transform -> 100 ms Delay -> Output; alternating routes
methodology.scheduling: At most 100 concurrent runs, step 200 virtual ms, then retention + 1 virtual ms per batch
methodology.gc_off: Automatic GC disabled; manual collection at every batch boundary and at the final boundary to respect heap safety limits
methodology.timer_delay: setTimeout(0) scheduled before each synchronous workload batch; measures event-loop delay including dispatch, diagnostic queries and GC
methodology.dispatch_time: Sums start and virtual-time dispatch calls; automatic GC is included when triggered in these calls
methodology.gc_time: Engine Performance.now measurements; GC time overlaps dispatch time and must not be added to it
methodology.memory: WASM linear memory is allocator high-water capacity; collection releases managed slots; allocated linear-memory pages remain available for reuse
methodology.isolation: Fresh browser page and WASM instance per scenario; 20 unmeasured warmup runs before engine counter reset
